## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] perf — performance improvement
- [ ] security — security hardening
- [ ] refactor — code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] chore / build / ci — tooling or maintenance

## Checklist

- [ ] The code builds locally (`./gradlew :app:assembleDebug`).
- [ ] Unit tests pass (`./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest`).
- [ ] Lint passes (`./gradlew :app:lintDebug`).
- [ ] No secrets, keystores, or personal data are committed.
- [ ] User-facing strings are in `res/values/strings.xml` (not hardcoded).
